title: Ukraine war latest: Russia carries out 'mass drone attack' on major Ukrainian city; Zelenskyy plans Saudi trip
description: Volodymyr Zelenskyy is travelling to Saudi Arabia next week, with peace talks set to kick off there. He said his "team" will stay for talks with US officials. He confirmed the plan as he and European leaders met in Brussels - while Russia launched another drone attack on a Ukrainian city.

title: Without US intelligence, Ukraine will struggle to strike inside Russia
description: The U.S. decision to stop sharing military intelligence with Ukraine hobbles its ability to strike and defend against the Russian army. That increases the pressure on it to accept a peace deal being pushed by the Trump administration.

title: Trump envoy says Ukrainians ‘brought it on themselves’ after U.S. pauses aid, intelligence sharing
description: Keith Kellogg, Donald Trump’s special envoy to Ukraine and Russia, says Kyiv was given ‘fair warning’ by the White House before the U.S. President this week ordered the pause

title: Will Trump's pause on U.S. intel and weapons for Ukraine bring Zelenskyy and Putin closer to peace, or further away?
description: As Russia bombs Ukraine and Trump pushes Zelenskyy for a "better deal," what will it take to end the war Vladimir Putin started?

title: Cracks in Trump-Putin relation? US warns of sanctions against Russia as Ukraine war rages
description: US President Donald Trump’s statement comes after Russia’s drone and missile strike on Ukraine’s energy grid

title: Ukrainian Opposition Leaders Back Election Ban Till Ceasefire And Peace Agreement
description: Ukraine has banned elections under martial law, but Russia and US President Donald Trump's team have argued President Zelenskyy is not a legitimate leader and called for elections

title: Trump’s Ukraine envoy says Kyiv brought the pause in US intelligence sharing ‘on themselves’
description: The Trump administration’s special envoy to Ukraine and Russia said Thursday that Ukraine “brought it on themselves” in regard to the cutoff of intelligence sharing from the US.

title: Ukraine war latest: Europe must beat Russia in arms race, Poland warns - as Zelenskyy at emergency Ukraine talks
description: Volodymyr Zelenskyy and European leaders are holding emergency Ukraine talks in Brussels, where the Ukrainian leader has thanked Europe "for staying with us" during a week in which Donald Trump attacked him in the White House, paused military aid and suspended intelligence sharing.

title: Russia launches deadly drone attacks on Ukraine
description: A Russian drone strike on a shipping facility here killed one civilian worker early Thursday, just 18 miles from where Ukrainian forces continue to hold territory in the Kremlin's Kursk region.
